emo-love: Head only (no body, no legs), facing the viewer, eyes turned into big red hearts, huge happy smile.
emo-cry: Head only (no body, no legs), facing the viewer, crying loudly with big blue tear streams pouring from both eyes, wobbly open mouth.
emo-angry: Head only (no body, no legs), facing the viewer, angry: furrowed brows drawn above the eyes, gritted teeth, a small red anger vein mark on the forehead.
emo-sleepy: Head only (no body, no legs), facing the viewer, sleeping with eyes closed as calm curved lines, a small blue snot bubble at the side, peaceful mouth.
emo-cool: Head only (no body, no legs), facing the viewer, wearing black sunglasses, confident smirk.
emo-thinking: Head and one gloved hand only: hand touching the chin, eyes looking up to the side, puzzled small mouth.
emo-shocked: Head only (no body, no legs), facing the viewer, shocked: eyes huge with tiny pupils, mouth wide open in a scream, face slightly blue at the top.
emo-sweat: Head only (no body, no legs), facing the viewer, awkward nervous smile showing teeth, one big blue sweat drop on the side of the head.
emo-blush: Head only (no body, no legs), facing the viewer, shy happy smile, eyes closed as happy arcs, rosy pink cheeks.
emo-kiss: Head only (no body, no legs), facing the viewer, blowing a kiss with puckered lips, one eye winking, one small red heart floating next to the lips.
emo-tongue: Head only (no body, no legs), facing the viewer, playful face with tongue sticking out and one eye closed.
emo-dizzy: Head only (no body, no legs), facing the viewer, dizzy with spiral eyes and a wavy mouth.
emo-thumbs: Head and one gloved hand only: a big thumbs-up next to the face, bright confident grin.
emo-ok: Head and one gloved hand only: an OK hand sign (thumb and finger circle) next to the face, cheerful wink.
emo-wave: Head and one gloved hand only: waving hello next to the face, big friendly smile.
emo-wai: Head and both gloved hands only: palms pressed together in front of the chin in a Thai wai, eyes closed, gentle smile.
emo-party: Head only (no body, no legs), facing the viewer, wearing a small blue-and-yellow party hat tilted on its head, blowing a party horn, happy eyes.
emo-sick: Head only (no body, no legs), facing the viewer, feeling sick: white face mask over the mouth, droopy tired eyes.
emo-facepalm: Head and one gloved hand only: palm covering the face in a facepalm, one exasperated eye visible between the fingers.
emo-stars: Head only (no body, no legs), facing the viewer, amazed with eyes turned into big shining yellow stars, open-mouth grin.
